phone_parity.scope: Only compiled HUD presentation changes. Java/native engine, other 37 compiled game modules and shipping project settings match previous verified phone APK.

modal_visibility.method: Every complete UI snapshot in five actual Android transcripts is checked. Mobile and both lifecycle transcripts include full paused UI: no visible chain or gameplay buttons, modal controls available; playing restores both HUD actions. Ordinary/latched gameplay transcripts only retain complete playing UI, with condensed pause snapshots covered separately by existing touch regressions. UI headless tests separately cover hints and nested settings/build.

layouts.scope: Three additional announcement geometry/touch assertions per viewport, same 188 requested layouts. Synthetic mutation message tests long text; not an earned mutation.

visual_review.observation: Native labelled cooldown and rendered long-mutation-message boards are synthetic fixtures. Actual Mobile resumes with earned Memory Tether and a visible upgrade banner. All three show the banner below the operative and above the touch row, clear of the joystick/dash and central combat area. Exact Android read-time quantification is not exposed by the probe; GUI dispatch tests cover lifetime/fade.

limits: Remaining announcement read time/fade proven in Godot GUI dispatch tests; actual Android screenshots validate layout, not a quantitative Android timer measurement.
